title: In-Place Home Resale Listing Term, Extension and Withdrawal Fee Schedule
content:
**Schedule to the In-Place Home Resale listing agreement.** The listing term, the extensions a listing may receive and the withdrawal fee differ by package as follows. The listing term runs from the listed date; the Resale Approval Service has no listing and therefore no listing term.

| Package | Listing term (days from the listed date) | Length of one extension (days) | Extensions a listing may receive | Fee per extension (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | not applicable (no listing) | not applicable | 0 | not applicable |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 90 | 60 | 1 | 95.00 |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 120 | 60 | 1 | 0.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 150 | 60 | 1 | 0.00 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 180 | 90 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 120 | not offered | 0 | not offered |

| Package | Withdrawal fee for a listed home (USD) | Days after the listed date from which withdrawal carries no fee |
|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | 0.00 | not applicable (no withdrawal fee) |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 0.00 | not applicable (no withdrawal fee) |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 295.00 | 60 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 495.00 | 60 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 695.00 | 60 |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 995.00 | 90 |

## Longest possible listing (derived from the table)

Each extension adds its length to the listing expiration date, so a listing that receives every extension it may receive runs for the term plus each extension:

| Package | Term | Extensions | Longest listing (days from the listed date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 90 | one of 60 | 150 |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 120 | one of 60 | 180 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 150 | one of 60 | 210 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 180 | two of 90 | 360 |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 120 | none | 120 |
